visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A silver, ergonomic foot scraper is held in focus against a wooden floor background, its textured surface visibly coated with white, powdery skin residue. Large pink animated text '矮噁' shakes on screen, followed by '(超多)' in smaller white text. The person's hand has manicured nails. (2) Tight close-up shots of toes with dry, white calluses are shown, labeled with yellow 'BEFORE' text. A finger points to the rough skin. The frame then transitions to show smooth, hydrated skin with a pinkish healthy glow, labeled with yellow 'AFTER' and '嫩白透亮' text overlays. (3) A young woman with long, straight brown hair and a grey off-the-shoulder knitted top appears, speaking directly to the camera. She has natural makeup and small earrings. The setting is a bright, warm indoor room with a soft bed and pillows visible in the blurred background. (4) Close-up view of a person's heels being scraped by the silver tool. White flakes fall off. A small gold and white ampoule bottle is shown being squeezed, dispensing a clear liquid onto the skin. Labels like '超近距離' and '超多死皮厚繭' appear in white and red boxes. (5) The woman returns to the frame, holding both the silver scraper and the ampoule bottle. She gestures with her hands as she speaks excitedly. A white rectangular card with '2025 Anniversary Celebration' and '刮刮卡' (lottery card) text is held up to the camera lens. (6) A full-screen graphic displays various prizes: cash piles, iPhone 17 Pro Max boxes, Chanel and Louis Vuitton bags, and Hermès boxes. Large gold numbers '2,000,000' and '總獎金' are prominent. The woman then holds up a white zippered makeup bag with 'HEERS' branding. (7) In the final segment, the woman points downwards with both index fingers towards the bottom of the frame. Brightly colored arrows (red, yellow, green) point down, accompanied by text overlays '下殺5折!!' and '活動連結'. She maintains a wide, cheerful smile and direct eye contact.
